hints.tr: `params = parse_qs(query)` sonra `params["city"]` bir liste: `['Ankara']`. Metni almak için `params["city"][0]`.
hints.en: `params = parse_qs(query)`, then `params["city"]` is a list: `['Ankara']`. To get the text use `params["city"][0]`.
To join the tags use `", ".join(tags)`; their number is `len(tags)`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
from urllib.parse import parse_qs

query = "city=Ankara&units=imperial&tag=sea&tag=museum&tag=castle"
params = parse_qs(query)

city = params["city"][0]
units = params["units"][0]
tags = params["tag"]

print(city)
print(units)
print(len(tags), "tags:", ", ".join(tags))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
from urllib.parse import parse_qs

query = "city=Ankara&units=imperial&tag=sea&tag=museum&tag=castle"
params = parse_qs(query)

city = params["city"][0]
units = params["units"][0]
tags = params["tag"]

print(city)
print(units)
print(len(tags), "tags:", ", ".join(tags))
```
